messages:
sam: Inbound H100 shipment AWB: 1Z999AA10123456784 arrived at FRA crossdock, warehouse flagged SKU mismatch on unpack. Holding for inspection. Can procurement/vendor advise on replacement flow? Photos attached to thread.
marie: Warehouse scanned serials, several units labeled H100-v1 but pallet manifest says H100-v2. photos: https://storage.redwood/shipments/1763141592/photos.zip Holding per customs until clarification.
priya: Vendor ACME was supposed to ship H100-v2. @linus (vendor-acme) can you confirm what went out from your end? We need to avoid customs tariff misclassification.
linus (vendor-acme): Checked pick records — we shipped batch 57 marked H100-v2. Very odd. Send over the photos/serials and I'll check the DC manifest.
marie: Here are serials we scanned: S/N: H100V1-001,H100V1-002,H100V1-003,H100V1-004,H100V1-005. manifest line shows: `SKU:H100-V2 | QTY:10 | AWB:1Z999AA10123456784`.
sam: If vendor shipped wrong SKU, we need RMA and expedited replacement or top-off. What's ETA for replacements? We have dedicated capacity commitments starting next week and can't afford extended delay.
linus (vendor-acme): Investigating with our fulfillment center. Two possibilities: mislabel at packing or an external repack. I'll confirm within 2h. If it's our error, we'll cover air replacement and return labels.
ops-bot: Automated note: Capacity impact estimate: 0.8 p95 latency increase if 8 H100s delayed for 48h on eu-prod cluster. See /ops/impact-1763141592 for details.
sam: :grimacing: Not great. If replacements delayed >48h we need to trigger isolated burst from us-east to avoid SLOs. @priya can we authorize cross-region burst?
priya: We have a small emergency pool in us-east. Approving emergency burst up to 12 GPUs for 72h. Billing informed (ticket #BILL-4821). Please document usage.
customs-eu: Heads up — if the commercial invoice/manifest changes we must refile HS code 8471.80. If vendor provides corrected commercial invoice we can release without additional duties. Upload corrected invoice to the portal.
linus (vendor-acme): Confirmed packing error at our DC — wrong labels applied to 8 units. We will ship 8 replacement H100-v2 units via overnight air, new AWB: XYZ123AIR. We'll also provide prepaid return labels for the H100-v1s to the FRA depot. ETA 24h.
marie: Please send digital return labels and COAs. Warehouse needs scheduled pickup details if the H100-v1s leave custody. We'll quarantine the affected serials until pickup is confirmed.
linus (vendor-acme): Uploaded `replacement_invoice_57.pdf`, `return_labels_57.zip`, and corrected commercial invoice with HS 8471.80 to https://s3.redwood/vendor-uploads/57/. Also adding `serial_map_v57.csv`.
sam: Thanks. Please confirm serial remap so we don't mark these as DOA when replacements arrive. Also include firmware revision notes for v2 units and whether any zero-touch config differs.
linus (vendor-acme): Will include firmware notes and serial_map. Apologies for the disruption — we'll bill shipping to our account and cover any customs refile if it's our fault.
sam: :thumbsup: Closing loop once replacements are scanned in. @ops-bot please monitor cluster and trigger cross-region burst if replacements are not scanned by 1763228000.
